title: Double-Phase Neumann Problems with Variable Growth on Metric Measure Spaces
summary: We study a variable-exponent double-phase Neumann problem on a domain in a metric measure space, where the boundary measure satisfies an upper codimension-\(θ\) bound for \(0\leθ<1\). Under a local comparability condition on the double-phase growth function, we establish a modular estimate for a fractional maximal operator and use it to prove the existence and boundedness of the associated trace operator.
